paper: Hu et al., Nature Plants 2023, Multi-Knock
fixture_scope: Locked regression fixture checks whether the designer can regenerate the published validation-construct spacer from target contexts. It is not a 5,635-guide library benchmark and not a full-current-database benchmark.
evidence_class: published post-screen validation construct; not verified as a member of the 5,635-guide transportome library
paper_method_statement: The Methods state that the 20 nt protospacer CTCTACTTTCTCCCTCATCT was picked to target PUP7, PUP8 and PUP21 at once.
paper_figure_distinction: Figure 5 states that the screen-derived CR8/21 sgRNA was not designed to target PUP7 because PUP7 lacks the respective PAM for that guide; CR8/21 is the PUP8/PUP21 double-mutant line.
interpretation: The published sequence used here is therefore treated as a separate PUP7/PUP8/PUP21 validation construct, not as a verified guide from the transportome library. Direct Supplementary Data 1 inspection is required before any library-membership or library-rediscovery claim.
rediscovery_definition: Exact spacer recovery means the design algorithm emits the identical 20-nt published spacer. Target compatibility (exact matches, mismatches and PAMs per gene) is reported separately and does not change exact sequence identity.
supplementary_data_1_direct_inspection_s: not directly retrieved in the v1.3.1 artifact environment; Nature landing page identifies Supplementary Data 1 as the all-family sgRNA library, so library membership remains unverified here.
